component.name: Sleep Control
component.summary: Keep the computer awake, or let it sleep again

description.p: Sleep Control stops the computer from going to sleep while something long runs, such as a download, a backup or a game update. Turn it off again and the computer sleeps as your power settings say.

It sits in the system tray and shows whether sleep is blocked. Pick Keep awake, Allow sleep or Sleep now from the tray menu, from the app window, or from a terminal. The block is asked for through the desktop's Inhibit portal and ends as soon as the app quits.
First beta of the Flatpak app: tray icon, window and terminal commands, with the block held through the Inhibit portal.
